conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Sarah from Amazon Security. We noticed a security flag on your account regarding a recent transaction and just need to verify some information to protect you.
Um, hi. I don't think I made any unusual transactions. What happened?

I understand your concern. There was an attempt to purchase a $950 gaming console from your Amazon account about 30 minutes ago. For your protection, the order is on hold while we verify your identity.
Oh, no. I didn't buy anything like that. What do I need to do?

Don't worry. We're here to help. To ensure your account is secure and prevent any unauthorized charges, I'll need to confirm a few details. Can you provide your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account?
Okay, um, it's Jamie Turner and my email is jamie.t123@email.com.
Thank you, Jamie. Please stay on the line as we go through some quick steps. Have you recently shared your Amazon password with anyone or noticed any suspicious emails?
No, I haven't given my password to anyone. I just got worried because I saw your call.

You did the right thing by answering. Now, to secure your account, we need to initiate a temporary hold and process a security verification. Do you have access to your computer or smartphone right now?
Yeah, I have my laptop open.
Perfect. Please open your web browser and type in 'supportverify.me'. This is Amazon's secure verification portal. Let me know once you see the page.
Okay, I'm there. It's asking for a code.
Great job. I'll generate your one-time verification code. Please enter 342119 and click 'Continue.'
Alright, I did that. It's asking for my Amazon account password now.
That's normal procedure for our secure portal. Please enter your password so we can authenticate your account and stop the fraudulent order.
Uh, okay. I typed it in.

Thank you, Jamie. You're helping us keep your account safe. Now, I'm seeing an attempted transfer to a foreign address. To prevent permanent suspension, we need to verify your billing details. Can you confirm the last four digits of your bank account linked to Amazon?
It should be 1876, I think.
Thank you. I'll need you to check your bank app for any recent Amazon charges. Please log in and let me know if you see anything unfamiliar.
I'm looking now. There's a charge for $950 pending.

That's the fraudulent transaction. To stop it and issue a refund, we need to follow Amazon's anti-fraud protocol. You'll receive a refund, but first, we must confirm your account ownership through a temporary payment hold. Are you comfortable with that?
If it's just temporary, I guess so. I don't want to lose my money.

Absolutely, it's only a verification step. For your security, Amazon requires this via a secure payment method. Do you have access to any local stores, like Walmart or Walgreens, where you can purchase Amazon gift cards?
Um, I think there's a Walgreens nearby. Do I really have to do this?

Yes, unfortunately it's the only way to prove account ownership and release your refund. If this step isn't completed, the fraudulent order may process and your account could be frozen for up to 60 days.
Oh, okay. How much do I need to get?
You'll need to purchase two Amazon gift cards for $500 each. Once you have them, please stay on the line and let me know the codes so I can verify and process the cancellation immediately.
Alright, I'll go get them now. Can you stay on the line with me?
Of course, I'll stay with you through the entire process. Remember, this is for your protection and to ensure your funds are safe.
I'm back. I bought two $500 cards.
Excellent. Please read the codes to me slowly so I can validate them in our system. This is required to activate your refund hold.
Okay, the first code is 3X7Q-9F5R-2L8P, and the second is 6H2Y-1M4K-7J2S.
Thank you, Jamie. I'm submitting those now. Please wait while it processes, it shouldn't take more than a minute.
Did it work? Will my account be okay?

Almost done. I see a system flag; it appears your account verification failed due to a mismatch. If we don't complete a second verification within the hour, your account may be permanently suspended and the refund will not process.
Oh no, I don't want that to happen. What do I do now?
Don't worry, we can fix this. You'll need to repeat the hold process. Please purchase one more $500 Amazon gift card now and provide the code to avoid account suspension and legal proceedings.
Okay, I'll go now. Please wait for me.
